Jamy nous explique comment est apparu cette île au milieu de l’océan, l’histoire des volcans qui la constituent et il nous raconte comment la végétation a colonisé progressivement cette petite île volcanique.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le Mont-Blanc, l’Aiguille du Midi, les Drus, les Grandes Jorasses... Autant de lieux mythiques de l’alpinisme français que Fred, Jamy et Sabine sont partis explorer afin de nous faire partager les sensations d’un sport extrême : l’escalade. Entre prouesses des plus grands - Catherine Destivelle, Patrick Bérhault, François Legrand... - et somptueux paysages, ils nous font découvrir les techniques et les lois physiques qui se cachent derrière ce sport qui fait grimper l’adrénaline au sommet ! Comment les grimpeurs évoluent-ils le long de la paroi lorsqu’ils forment une cordée ? Si un grimpeur chute, quelle force s’exercera sur le mousqueton qui retient la corde ? Quel est l’avantage d’avoir des cordes qui s’allongent ? Et le facteur de chute, comment ça se calcule

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy suivent le Cirque Gruss pendant plusieurs jours et nous font découvrir un univers magique et rigoureux. Ils nous entraînent sous le chapiteau pour observer de près l'entraînement des acrobates et des jongleurs et le maquillage des clowns. Ils s'initient aux techniques de dressage des chevaux et nous expliquent quels sont les différents corps de métier qui évoluent dans un cirque.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy nous emmènent faire les vendanges en Bourgogne et nous révèlent les secrets de fabrication du vin. Vendanges, fermentation et macération dans les cuves, notions de terroir et influence du climat... ils nous livrent les clés d'un vin réussi. Nos deux compères nous proposent également une dégustation de vin en compagnie d'une oenologue qui en fait un examen complet et nous explique le rôle des fûts de chêne, de la mise en bouteille et de la fabrication des bouchons en liège. Quel rôle le soleil joue-t-il dans le mûrissement du raisin ? Comment le sucre se transforme-t-il en alcool ? Qu'est-ce que c'est le collage du vin ? Quels peuvent être les effets et les dangers de la consommation d'alcool ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy nous entraînent dans le service Infos de la rédaction de France 3 à Paris et nous expliquent comment se fabrique un journal national comme le 19/20. De la conférence de rédaction au travail du présentateur, en passant par le rôle des Journalistes Reporters d'Images, ils nous dévoilent les étapes nécessaires à la réalisation d'un journal télévisé. Quelles sont les sources d'informations des journalistes ? A quoi servent les agences de presse ? Quels sont les moyens techniques qui permettent les reportages en direct ? De quels effets spéciaux se sert-on pour le bulletin météo ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy nous entraînent à Lacq dans les Pyrénées Atlantiques où l'on trouve le plus grand gisement français de gaz en exploitation. Fred nous guide dans une usine où l'on extrait du gaz brut localisé à 3500 m de profondeur. Accompagné d'un géologue, il nous explique comment prospecter les poches de gaz et détecter la présence d'hydrocarbures. Il continue son périple dans une usine de mise en bouteille du butane et du propane (G.P.L: gaz de pétrole liquéfié); puis dans un gazoduc dont nous découvrons le fonctionnement. Fred part pour Montoir de Bretagne visiter un méthanier qui transporte le gaz sous forme liquide refroidi à -163 °. De retour en ville, il part à la chasse aux fuites de gaz avec un véhicule renifleur. Jamy nous explique ce que le gaz, comment il s'est formé dans le sous-sol, comment faire remonter le gaz naturel dans un réservoir, comment garder le gaz liquide en bouteille et pourquoi le gaz cause des explosions.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy nous ouvrent les portes du Musée Electropolis de Mulhouse pour évoquer en notre compagnie l’origine de l’électricité et l'utilisation que nous en faisons au quotidien. Ils se font ensuite nos guides pour parcourir la grande exposition de la Cité des Sciences et de l’Industrie de La Villette. Là, nous plongeons avec eux au cœur de la prise, de l’ampoule, de la pile et du générateur. De quoi ressortir… électrisé !

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Direction le marché de Rungis, le plus grand marché de produits frais au monde. Fred y passe la nuit et parcourt en vélo les 232 hectares que recouvrent ce marché, où se croisent 20 000 acheteurs en moyenne. Dans le pavillon de la marée, il assiste à l'arrivage des poissons en provenance directe des ports de France, de Norvège ou du Danemark, et nous explique comment on le maintient frais pendant son transport et sur les étals. Nous le suivons dans les entrepôts frigorifiques, dans le pavillon des fruits et légumes, mais aussi dans le pavillon de la viande où nous rencontrons des vétérinaires chargés de contrôler l'hygiène. Nous évoquons également la maladie de la vache folle et les mesures mises en place depuis cette affaire. Jamy nous explique le parcours des produits frais. Du maraîcher à notre assiette, comment la glace protège-t-elle le poisson de la formation des bactéries ? Comment un réfrigérateur fonctionne-t-il ? Que se passe-t-il quand un fruit mûrit ? Comment conserver des aliments ? Qu'est-ce que la maladie de la vache folle ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: La veille de Noël, Fred et Jamy abandonnent leur camion-atelier pour un voyage pittoresque au cœur du Queyras, dans le village de Saint-Véran. Ce sera l'occasion pour découvrir les activités traditionnelles : la fromagerie, le four à pain, la vie des bergers etc. Jamy nous expliquera comment faire du fromage, pourquoi la laine des moutons tient chaud...

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy partent explorer la mine d'or de Lauriéras, dans le Limousin. Entre techniques de prospection et chantiers d'extraction, ils suivent tout le filon ! Après une petite promenade dans une rivière en compagnie d’un orpailleur, nous découvrons comment on traite le minerai d'or et comment sont fabriqués les lingots. Qu’est-ce que c’est l'or ? Comment un filon se forme-t-il ? A quoi ça ressemble, une mine d'or ? Qu’est-ce que c’est, un carat ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Quel est cet étrange phénomène qui fait fondre les glaciers, monter le niveau des mers, et déclenche cyclones et tempêtes ? Pouvons-nous y changer quelque chose ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred, Jamy et Sabine sont à Rochefort. Ils suivent la construction d'une réplique parfaite de la frégate qui emporta La Fayette vers les insurgés américains : l'Hermione.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Paquebots, cargos ou supertankers... Ils sont en acier et pèsent des dizaines de milliers de tonnes, et pourtant ils flottent ! Comment font-ils pour ne pas couler, pour résister aux tempêtes et au poids de leurs cargaisons ? Et quelle force est capable de propulser de tels "monstres" ? En visitant les Chantiers de l'Atlantique à Saint Nazaire, nous découvrons comment ces navires sont construits, comment ils sont dessinés et étudiés pour résister à toutes les mers.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Quel circuit l’eau potable emprunte-t-elle avant d’arriver à notre robinet ? Comment la débarrasse-t-on des nitrates, pesticides et bactéries en tous genres ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Bactéries, insectes et autres bêtes microscopiques... Fred et Jamy nous ouvrent toutes grandes les portes de l’infiniment petit ! Fred s’est rendu au Muséum d'Histoire Naturelle pour faire la connaissance de toutes sortes d’organismes invisibles à l'œil humain. Il en profite pour nous expliquer comment fonctionnent les différents instruments qui permettent de les observer. Quels sont les instruments qui permettent de scruter ce qui nous est invisible ? Comment un microscope électronique fonctionne-t-il ? Cinéradiographie, endoscopie, ou échographie en 3 dimensions… quelles techniques permettent d’explorer l’intérieur d’un organisme ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy s'intéressent à L'Europe et à ses institutions. Ils se rendent à Strasbourg, au Parlement Européen, et à Bruxelles, siège de la Commission. En quoi consiste le travail des douanes maintenant que les frontières sont abolies ? Est-il possible de s'installer dans n'importe quel pays d'Europe, quand on est ressortissant européen ? Quel est le rôle de la Commission Européenne ? Quels sont ses organes de décision ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Depuis sa récolte jusqu'à sa transformation en un délicieux pain chaud, Fred et Jamy suivent le chemin du grain de blé. Après avoir participé à une moisson, ils nous font découvrir les différentes variétés de blé et suivent la transformation du grain en farine chez le meunier. Ils partent enfin chez un boulanger pour nous montrer comment se fabrique le pain.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy nous emmènent observer les fourmis. Leur camion prend la direction de Mulhouse et s'arrête dans une forêt de conifères où vivent des fourmis des bois. Fred nous dévoile les caractéristiques d'une fourmilière et de ses habitantes. Cet insecte, appelé hyménoptère existe depuis des millions d'années. En France, on en a dénombré au moins 180 espèces différentes. Nous verrons comment les colonies de fourmis s'organisent et se reproduisent grâce à leur reine, et quel est le rôle écologique joué par les fourmis des bois qui se nourrissent essentiellement d'insectes. Au vivarium, Fred nous montre le travail des fourmis "fourrageuses" chargées d'alimenter leurs colonies. Nous parlerons également des fourmis plus redoutables comme les "champignonnistes" ou les "magnans" d'Afrique. Puis, nous irons dans un laboratoire de Toulouse où on étudie la fourmi d'Argentine qui élève des pucerons pour les "traire".

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Des fibres naturelles aux fibres du futur … Fred et Jamy remontent la filière des textiles innovants. Le camion-laboratoire fait étape à Lille à l'Institut Français du Textile et de l’Habillement puis à Lyon, où les textiles naturels ou synthétiques subissent tous les tests possibles et imaginables. Au fil de leurs escales, les sorciers nous dévoilent les secrets de nos vêtements de demain : respirants et imperméables, textiles « anti-tout » , nanostructurés ou imitants la nature, cosmétotextiles. Puis nous suivons enfin la filière du recyclage et des fibres bio.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Un quart de siècle après son apparition, le SIDA est toujours là. C'est même une véritable pandémie ! Toutes les 7 secondes, une personne est contaminée dans le monde. Et toutes les 10 secondes, c'en est une autre qui en meurt...Grâce aux nouveaux traitements et aux campagnes de prévention, le nombre des malades commence enfin à se stabiliser. Mais ce virus demeure un fléau mondial. Et la France - qui est l'un des pays les plus touchés d'Europe - est loin d'être épargnée. Entre échecs et réussites, Fred et Jamy dressent le bilan de plus de 25 années de lutte contre le SIDA. Mission : Fred part explorer les laboratoires de l'Institut Pasteur pour tracer le portrait de ce virus qui sème la zizanie dans notre système immunitaire. Nous le retrouvons également en compagnie d'un séropositif qui lui raconte comment, la trithérapie est parvenue à le protéger contre cette terrible maladie. Puis c'est avec le Pr Yves Lévy que Fred évoque le patient travail des chercheurs pour tenter de trouver un vaccin contre ce virus qui se transforme en permanence

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Des protons lancés à près de 300 000 km par seconde dans de longs tuyaux enfouis sous la terre ? La drôle de machine qui réalise cet exploit atteint 27 kilomètres de circonférence et traverse la frontière franco-suisse de part en part. Elle devrait bientôt nous permettre d'en savoir plus sur la matière qui constitue notre Univers. Fred et Jamy sont partis découvrir le plus grand collisionneur de particules du monde. Entre protons, neutrons, quarks et gluons... ils plongent dans l'univers de l'infiniment petit et nous livrent les secrets de tous ces minuscules grains de matières qui nous composent.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Et si l'hydrogène était l'énergie du futur ? Aux quatre coins de la planète, on planche sur cette source d'énergie prometteuse… Il faut dire que ce gaz a de sérieux atouts : combiné à l'oxygène, il libère beaucoup d'énergie… et ne rejette que de l'eau. Pas une trace de ce fameux CO2 qui pose tant de problèmes à notre planète ! Seuls hics à ce qui pourrait être un véritable conte de fée écologique : ce gaz est difficile à stocker, terriblement explosif, et sa production reste encore très gourmande en énergie. Fred et Jamy nous offrent un tour d'horizon de toutes les avancées technologiques qui feront peut-être de l'hydrogène… l'énergie de demain !

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy partent dans le Sahara, à la rencontre des derniers nomades du Sud marocain, qui se sont adaptés à la vie dans le désert. L'homme ne pourrait pas survivre très longtemps sous cette latitude sans son fidèle compagnon : le dromadaire.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Dans le Sud marocain, Fred découvre le Sahara. Ce désert, le plus vaste de la planète, n'est pas recouvert que par des dunes. C'est à 80% un désert de pierres. Dans son laboratoire, Jamy explique pourquoi les pluies sont si rares dans cette région du globe.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy découvrent les oasis du Sud marocain. Sur place, Fred raconte comment leurs habitants se partagent la terre et exploitent la moindre goutte d'eau grâce à d'extraordinaires systèmes d'irrigation. Depuis son camion-laboratoire, Jamy explique d'où provient l'eau du désert.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: De nouveaux travaux de réaménagément sont en cours au premier étage de la tour Eiffel. Les deux grands pavillons sont en phase de reconstruction et accueilleront une salle de spectacle ainsi qu'un espace dédié à Gustave Eiffel. Quant au plancher opaque du premier étage, il sera partiellement remplacé par un sol en verre afin de donner au public l'impression de marcher dans le vide.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Pourquoi le lait est-il blanc ? Pourquoi y a-t-il des trous dans le gruyère ? Et pourquoi bat-on le lait pour en faire du beurre ? Fred, Jamy et Sabine nous expliquent tout sur le lait et les produits laitiers. Nous découvrons avec eux l'art de battre, de fouetter, de broyer le lait pour en obtenir un beurre jaune et délicat ou de délicieux fromages...

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: L’équipe de C’est pas sorcier a eu le privilège de voler à bord du Zeppelin NT, un dirigeable dernier cri. Sabine a survolé la vallée de la Seine à bord de cet engin qui peut atteindre 130 km/h tout en donnant l’impression de flotter doucement dans les airs. En compagnie du pilote français Dominique Manière, elle nous explique comment se pilote cette drôle de machine qui vole grâce à un gaz plus léger que l’air , l’hélium, et qui tient à la fois du bateau , de l’hélicoptère , et de l’avion. Soixante ans après la disparition des dirigeables gigantesques qui sillonnaient le ciel des années trente, la firme Zeppelin – mère du fameux Hindenburg – espère relancer ce mode de transport. Le Zeppelin NT n’est pour le moment destiné qu’au tourisme, mais il pourrait bientôt ouvrir la voie à d’autres types de navires des airs. On parle déjà de monstres volants qui emporteraient de très lourdes charges d’une manière à la fois économique et écologique...

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Dans l’univers, tous les corps s’attirent : c’est la gravitation. Pourquoi ne pèse-t-on plus rien quand on est en impesanteur ? Les spationautes et leur vaisseau chutent sans cesse autour de la Terre. Pourquoi ne s’écrasent-ils pas ? Pourquoi est-on désorienté et a-t-on du mal à contrôler nos mouvements lorsque l’on est en impesanteur ? Fred a suivi un petit entraînement pour devenir astronaute. L’occasion pour Jamy de nous offrir quelques éclaircissements sur l’impesanteur et de nous présenter l’ISS, la future station spatiale internationale qui, d’ici 2006, devrait avoir remplacé la défunte MIR.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Pourquoi nos mains restent-elles collées à la glace quand on la touche ? Pourquoi les glaçons flottent-ils dans l'eau ? Et quand on met un glaçon dans l'eau, c'est le glaçon qui refroidit l'eau ou l'eau qui réchauffe le glaçon ? Les sorciers nous expliquent tout sur la glace. Nous suivons Fred dans l'ascension périlleuse d'une cascade de glace, tandis que Jamy nous donne une petite leçon de chimie pratique et rigolote autour de molécules d'eau qui dansent, se rapprochent ou se séparent...

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Jusqu’au XIXème siècle, c’est l’éclairage au gaz qui domine, même s’il est parfois remplacé par les lampes à pétrole. En 1881 c’est la révolution : Thomas Edison présente au monde la lampe à incandescence. Cet éclairage électrique, plus puissant et moins dangereux que le gaz, prend vite le pas sur les autres. En quelques dizaines d’années, Paris et toute la France succombent aux charmes de la fée électricité. Fred et Jamy reviennent sur les origines de cette invention qui a totalement révolutionné notre environnement urbain et notre vie.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Chaque année en France, les orages font d’importants dégâts et environ une dizaine de personnes sont victimes de la foudre. Pour comprendre ce qui provoque ces colères du ciel, l’équipe de C’est pas sorcier part traquer les cumulonimbus et les éclairs en compagnie d’un chasseur d’orage.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Chaque année, 80 Millions de voyageurs et 130 Millions de tonnes de marchandises transitent à travers l’arc alpin. Cette barrière naturelle, à la frontière de 4 pays - la France, l’Italie, la Suisse et l’Autriche- est l’un des plus grands carrefours d'Europe. Fred et Jamy nous emmènent visiter le chantier du Saint Gothard, un tunnel de 57 km de long, creusé entre le Nord et le Sud de la Suisse. Il devrait être achevé en 2017 et sera alors le plus long du monde. Avec l'élargissement de l'Union européenne, le trafic de marchandises y est en constante augmentation et la pollution aussi. Pour désengorger les routes et les voies ferrées, de nouveaux tunnels ferroviaires sont en construction ou en projet. Ils permettront de faire voyager les camions sur des trains. Mission : Contrairement aux premiers tunnels alpins creusés dans les crêtes des montagnes, les nouveaux tunnels sont construits aux pieds des Alpes. Ces chantiers sont titanesques. Fred descend dans les entrailles de la montagne, sur le front de taille, où le tunnelier dévore la roche et avance avec une précision d'une dizaine de centimètres. Il y rencontre les géologues et les géomètres qui ont réalisé le tracé du tunnel et nous expliquent tous les défis techniques qu'ils doivent relever.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Situées à 18 000 kilomètres de Paris, les 118 îles de la Polynésie sont des petits bouts de France nichés au coeur de l'océan Pacifique. 118 petits paradis qui ne se limitent pas aux belles plages désertes et aux vahinés ondulantes...Avec leurs volcans surgis de l'océan et leurs atolls aux eaux bleu turquoise, leur histoire géologique est passionnante ! Surtout, elles abritent une culture trop mal connue : celle des maohis, qui, pour coloniser ces cailloux minuscules, traversèrent le plus grand océan de la planète à bord de leurs étonnantes pirogues. Fred et Jamy sont partis explorer ces îles du bout du monde. Mission : Gigantesques volcans qui surgissent de l'océan à leur naissance, les îles de la Polynésie s'usent, s'érodent, s'enfoncent... pour laisser place à des anneaux de corail tout plats - des atolls - qui disparaîtront à leur tour. Fred est parti explorer les îles hautes de Moorea et de Bora-Bora pour comprendre cet étrange phénomène. Entre une rencontre avec un maître tatoueur, un tour de lagon en pirogue traditionnelle et une visite du très joli marché de Papeete sur l'île de Tahiti, Fred nous raconte ensuite l'histoire extraordinaire du peuple polynésien. Nous découvrons enfin la Polynésie d'aujourd'hui avec ses fermes perlières, ses beaux hôtels et ses cocoteraies...

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Comment l’île de la Réunion est-elle sortie de l’Océan Indien il y a 3 millions d’années ? Et comment la végétation qui la recouvre est-elle ensuite parvenue jusque sur ses rivages ? Fred est parti explorer cette île et son volcan, le Piton de la Fournaise, l’un des plus actifs au monde… Jusque dans ses entrailles.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: On recense, chaque année dans le monde, entre 60 et 80 attaques de requins. Ces attaques sont-elles de plus en plus nombreuses ? Sont-elles liées à un changement de comportement des requins ou provoquées par les activités humaines ? Fred part à La Réunion, à la rencontre d’une équipe de scientifiques qui mène l’enquête depuis la série d’attaques inhabituelles qui a eu lieu en 2011

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Chaque été, ils nous embêtent : ça pique, ça gratte… Ne nous plaignons pas, car les moustiques pourraient se révéler bien plus dangereux ! A La Réunion, ils ont ainsi provoqué une grosse épidémie de Chikungunya. Et certaines de ces espèces tropicales vectrices de maladies débarquent aujourd’hui dans les pays tempérés, dont l’Europe…

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Les tortues marines, qui vivent dans les eaux tropicales et subtropicales de la planète, sont toutes des espèces menacées. A La Réunion, où l’on peut croiser 5 des 7 espèces existant dans le monde, on s’efforce de les protéger et de les soigner. Et elles reviennent depuis peu au large des côtes et sur les plages !

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Si le soleil et les vagues font chaque été la joie des baigneurs, le bord de mer n’est pas sans dangers. Durant la période estivale 2012, 176 personnes sont mortes noyées sur le littoral français. Sabine et Jamy vont suivre le quotidien des nageurs sauveteurs de la SNSM, la société nationale de sauvetage en mer qui surveille près d’un tiers des plages françaises. L’an dernier, ils ont secourus plus de 1500 personnes.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Sabine et Jamy mettent le cap sur Aigues-Mortes, au Sud-Ouest de la Camargue. Depuis l’antiquité l’homme y aménage d’immenses lagunes pour cultiver le sel de mer. Aujourd’hui, ces marais salants s’étendent sur 10 000 hectares et produisent 250 000 tonnes par an. Mais derrière cette imposante activité économique se cache aussi un lieu de vie exceptionnel pour de nombreuses espèces, dont le majestueux flamant rose.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Les communes du littoral français sont de plus en plus menacées par l’érosion marine. Sur la côte Aquitaine près de 400 bâtiments risquent d’être engloutis par la mer d’ici 2040. Si les plages de sable sont les plus touchées, la côte rocheuse n’est pas épargnée. Jamy et Sabine se rendent sur la côte Atlantique et en Méditerranée pour constater ce recul du littoral et voir comment communes et particuliers tentent de lutter contre l’érosion marine.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Comment notre corps évolue-t-il dans l’air ? Jusqu’à quelle altitude peut-on sauter ? Comment fonctionne un parachute ? Pour le découvrir, Fred se rend à Tallard, dans les Hautes-Alpes pour une série de sauts en tandem. Il y prend possession de son matériel : altimètre, lunette, combinaison et parachutes. Puis, dans un petit avion à hélice, il grimpe à 4 000 mètres d’altitude, et se lance dans le vide. Jamy, quant à lui, décompose les différentes phases de la chute et de l’ouverture du parachute. Il nous explique pourquoi un parachutiste seul tombe plus lentement que des parachutistes en tandem. Il décortique enfin la fausse sensation de ralentissement que Fred a expérimenté.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Quand aucun traitement ne fonctionne plus, quand le coeur, les reins ou les poumons sont en bout de course, la greffe d'organe devient l'unique espoir de rémission. En France, chaque année, 12 000 personnes se retrouvent dans l'attente d'une greffe. Mais faute d'organes disponibles, seul un tiers d'entre elles y auront droit. Fred et Jamy ont suivi la course contre la montre que mènent les équipes de greffes. Une course pour la vie !

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: C'est pas sorcier s'attaque à la science du goût. Sabine et Jamy sont partis à la rencontre de Thierry Marx et de son équipe. Nous découvrons avec eux comment ce grand chef, qui est capable de passer une anguille à l'IRM pour en détecter les nerfs inopportuns, ou de s'intéresser aux nanotechnologies pour améliorer ses recettes, a su mettre la science au service des saveurs. Du grand art ! Mission : Entre le laboratoire où cuisiniers, designers et scientifiques s'appliquent à mettre au point les dernières trouvailles du chef, et la salle du restaurant où d'heureux clients dégustent de véritables merveilles... Sabine s'est mêlée à la brigade de Thierry Marx pour découvrir avec nous comment se pratique la cuisine des chefs. Mission : Entre le laboratoire où cuisiniers, designers et scientifiques s'appliquent à mettre au point les dernières trouvailles du chef, et la salle du restaurant où d'heureux clients dégustent de véritables merveilles... Sabine s'est mêlée à la brigade de Thierry Marx pour découvrir avec nous comment se pratique la cuisine des chefs.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Nous allons voler à bord des hélicoptères de l’Aviation Légère de l’Armée de Terre et nous irons chez Eurocopter, premier fabricant d’hélicoptères en Europe. Fred expérimente le pilote d’une Gazelle, petit hélicoptère très maniable. Il nous montre comment décoller, rester sur place, manoeuvrer... Nous assisterons à un vol tactique avec une patrouille de Gazelles ainsi qu’à un vol de nuit grâce aux jumelles de vision nocturne. Jamy nous expliquera comment faire voler un objet plus lourd que l’air, comment l’hélicoptère décolle et se dirige et pourquoi il ne peut pas aller au-delà de 400km/heure

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy nous font partager une partie de bataille navale à grande échelle. Ils nous font parcourir les entrailles d’une vraie île flottante : le porte-avions Foch. A bord, Fred nous fait parcourir tous les étages du Foch. Nous pénétrons dans la salle des machines, le hangar des avions de défense, parcourons le pont d’envol et tous ses dangers, visitons les dortoirs et même un bloc opératoire. Du camion, Jamy nous explique la production d’électricité à base de propulsion à vapeur ou à base de propulsion nucléaire, comment se fait le catapultage et l’appontage des avions ainsi que les risques causés par le tangage et le roulis

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Nous partons à bord d'un sous-marin militaire pour les grandes profondeurs des océans. Nous découvrons les postes-clés et les équipements indispensables pour naviguer, ainsi que les lois physiques qui régissent la vie d'un sous-marin. Comment plonger et remonter ? Comment fabriquer de l'air pour respirer ? Comment naviguer dans le plus grand des silences pour ne pas être repéré ? Comment communiquer avec la surface et comment entendre les autres sous-marins ? Fred et Jamy répondent à toutes ces questions.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World’s Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events — including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal’s Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: It’s the final day of the Strongman Champions League’s first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120–200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. With fierce competition and last chances to qualify, the stakes couldn’t be higher.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals begin in Uppington, South Africa, after a global season of elite competition. Top athletes gather for a dramatic showdown, led by reigning champion and hometown hero Rayno Nel, as they battle in extreme events for the ultimate strongman title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World’s Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League kicks off its 2014 season in Martinique.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The second stage of 2014 Strongman champions League, in Cologne, Germany. 14 athletes from 12 different countries battled through six events on the second stop

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The third episode is hosted in Serbia where world records are broken!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fourth episode takes place in Finland with events such as Bus Pull and the forward hold

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stage of the SCL takes place in Holland with events such as the Atlas Stones and Truck Pull being witnessed

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL is in full swing and the sixth stage takes place in Latvia where the men are eager to break a national record held here

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competition continues in Portugal with 6 events and thousands of spectators

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Episode 8 takes place in 36 degree heat in Croatia and sees the return of Krzysztof Radzikowski after a 2 month absence due to injury

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL returns to Poland with 12 athletes all battling for the number one title

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 10th stage takes place in Hungary and features new super talent!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first ever SCL in Zambia! The athletes get to take in some of the stunning sights and go on to do events such as Tyre Flip and Log Lift

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competition moves to Romania and for the first time this season the athletes compete in rainy conditions which make the events even tougher

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition takes place in Lithunia and world records are once again broken!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Episode 14 takes place in Estonia where drama and world records will be seen again

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place over 2 days in Malaysia, this is part 1 of the world finals of Strongman Champions League!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League - we find out who is crowned as world champion today in the second part of the final epsiode

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Across seven rivers, through mountains and forests, 12 strongmen go to toughest places to find out who is strongest Viking in the World and open a new season of Strongman champions league for 2015. Events like the Hercules Hold, Yoke Race and pulling a real Viking ship are some of the ingredients of this fantastic show.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The second stage of Strongman champions league will be hosted in Germany, by FIBO - the leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health worldwide with 300,000 visitors in four days. Special implements like the biggest log in the world or the special Bavarian stone lift are not only a challenge, but also an opportunity for new personal, national and world records.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Holland is hosting 12 different countries with 14 of the strongest men in the world for the third stage of the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we go into the mountains of Austria to find out through six grueling events who is the strongest in the land of Alps. Martin Wildauer, current World Champion 2014 and Austrian local is competing alongside Zageris, Radzikowski, Belsak and many others.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 13th stage of Strongman Champions League is in Maia, Portugal. The competition is at the “Powerexpo” – one of the best sport and fitness events in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage is in Martinique and eight strongmen from all over the world will compete for the last chance to gather points before the world grand finals in December.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A special World championship under the newcomers and lightweights in the Strongman world. Some of them will step from this to the heavyweights divisions.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 15 outstanding competitions all over the world, finally we are here at the final competition of this year’s Strongman Champions League hosted in Turkey.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the land of Vikings - Norway - to the first stage of the SCL World Series 2016

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The second stage of the SCL heads to the FIBO convention, Cologne. The leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health hosts.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the third stage of SCL world series 2016, the athletes compete in Kaunas for the SCL Log Lift World Championships.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage four is an epic competition and a few surprises. With 14 strongmen from all over the world, one newcomer left quite an impression.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year Lauri Nami joins the starting list, back after last year's injury in Romania

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for the stage 6 of the MLO SCL. 11 compete for the title in the home country of legendary Ervin Katona.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the SCL. Current leader in the World Series is Matjaz Belsak, youngest competitor and strongest man of Slovenia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competitors battle it out in the special event, the Atlas Steel Stone. This stone is made completely from iron and cannot be touched with any support.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: 38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Recently, parents across America were googling “Who is Andrew Tate?” making him number three in Google searches for 2022, right behind Queen Elizabeth and Donald Trump. Tate claims to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. However, in August 2022, Tate was banned on social media for his misogynist viewpoints. Twenty-four-year-old Ben says when he was a teen, he had zero self-esteem, never got past the first date, and felt powerless with girls. He tells Dr. Phil that men like Tate inspired him to break out of his shell -- and he shares how. Then, a healthy debate about “toxic masculinity” with the “Godfather of the Manosphere," a scholar and author, a men’s rights attorney, and the CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Andrew Tate is known for his misogynistic social media posts and videos claiming to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. Tate is fighting a legal battle in Romania right now, but should parents worry about his influence on their sons? Before Tate was detained, Dr. Phil spoke with Richard Reeves, senior fellow at the Brookings Institute and author “Of Boys and Men: Why the Modern Male is Struggling, Why it Matters, and What to Do about It”; Marilyn York, a men’s rights attorney; Imran Ahmed, CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate; and blogger and author Rollo Tomassi. Plus, hear from a group of teenage boys who surprise their mothers when they share what they think about Tate. And, Robin joins the conversation.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.desc: The accuracy of eyewitness testimony from a rape victim is questioned.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rheta says her four-and-a-half-year marriage to Mark is headed down a rocky road, and her mother-in-law, Deb, is in the driver's seat. Rheta says it's time for Mark to cut the cord with the woman she calls deceitful, backstabbing, sneaky and controlling -- or else! Meanwhile, Deb says she hates Rheta, claiming she's violent, trashy and undeserving of her son. The tension between the women has escalated to blows on more than one occasion, leaving Mark literally in the middle. Where do his loyalties lie? Hear the drastic measures Deb has taken to get Rheta out of their lives. And, did Rheta reveal a secret in the hopes of ruining Deb's 31-year marriage? Is this a case of an overprotective mom overstepping her boundaries, or a wife's resentment getting the best of her? Dr. Phil mediates this war of words and helps to draw some lines in the sand. Whose side will Mark be on? Can this marriage and family be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Rachel, who accuses Walt of murdering her 14-year-old sister in 1985, despite his vehement denial. Walt claims Rachel might have been involved in her sister’s death -- an accusation she strongly denies. Both agree to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The drama continues as Dr. Phil goes on the hunt for con artists who cheat viewers out of thousands of dollars by posing as him and Robin.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The case of missing Stacy Peterson is discussed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The children of Drew Peterson deal with the reality of their father's suspected involvement in their mother's murder and stepmother's disappearance.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his exclusive jailhouse interview with Kelli Stapleton, a mother accused of trying to kill herself and her severely autistic 14-year-old daughter, Issy. Were there any warning signs that she was reaching her breaking point? And, find out how you can help Issy secure a healthy and productive future.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In September 2013, Kelli Stapleton and her 14-year-old daughter, Issy -- who suffers from severe autism -- were found in the family van, suffering from carbon monoxide poisoning. Could Kelli have done the unthinkable? In a Dr. Phil exclusive, the jailed Michigan mom opens up about what happened.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Doug and Debbie's once-perfect family has been shattered by the frightening reality that they could lose their 21-year-old son, Brandon, to drugs. Dr. Phil lays the groundwork for a successful intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a Dr. Phil exclusive, a 17-year-old football star accused of rape -- and the alleged victim -- speak out about how one alcohol-fueled night changed their lives in an instant. Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? And, how has the ordeal impacted her life? Plus, Matt’s parents, Dianne and Mark, insist their son is innocent and say they believe the alleged victim is out for attention. Dr. Phil has a powerful message for the couple.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into the dangers of teenage sex and underage drinking -- and how three families have been affected. In Part 2 of his exclusive interview, the 16-year-old girl who claims high school football star Matt and three other classmates raped her at a party opens up about what she says happened that night. Why does she say her peers care more about the accused football players than they do her? Don’t miss Matt and his parents’ reactions to what she has to say. Then, Leah alleges that in 2011, her 15-year-old daughter, Rehtaeh, was raped by four classmates at a party, and that after nearly a year-and-a-half of relentless bullying, the teen took her own life. How could this have been prevented? And what message does Leah have for others in similar situations? Plus, hear from Alexis, who says she too was raped at 15 and “could’ve been Rehtaeh.” What does she say got her through her darkest moments? Don’t miss this powerful cautionary tale for every teen and parent! This program contains strong sexual content.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, Gabby Petito’s parents speak out all together for the first time since the 22-year-old “Van Life” vlogger's body was discovered in Grand Teton National Park in Wyoming. As the manhunt for her fiancé, Brian Laundrie, continues, they share their knowledge about his survival skills, and talk about the heartbreaking moment her stepfather had to identify Gabby. They also honor her life and memory, and discuss what they hope will be her legacy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part 2 of Dr. Phil’s exclusive interview with Gabby Petito’s parents, who are all sitting down together for the first time, they share where they believe Brian Laundrie may be hiding, and what they hope happens to him if he was involved in Gabby’s death. Plus, see their reaction to the latest developments in their daughter’s case.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two women face the grandmother who they say did not protect them for the first time in 7 years.

programme.desc: Experience the electric atmosphere at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden as the high-stakes battle for the top four intensifies between the Hyderabad Superstars and Delhi Dilwale. With legendary co-owner Sunil Gavaskar watching from the sidelines, the Dilwale look to maintain their winning streak against a fiercely aggressive Hyderabad squad known for their wild celebrations and relentless energy. This tie features a series of high-octane clashes, from the strategic precision of Shawn Mendes and Alejandra Lopez in women’s singles to the "grueling" 15-minute sprints of elite doubles play. As the "Band of Honor" leaderboard hangs in the balance, every rally becomes a desperate fight for survival in one of the world's most prestigious pickleball arenas.

programme.desc: A few years back, we rallied up with my buddy Chris Atkins who owns and operates Central America fishing. He told me, Shea, you have to do a Stoked On Fishing Charters Panama trip and fish at Coiba National Park. It's the largest island in Central America, next to the world-famous Hannibal Bank. Needless to say, we rallied up the troops and made our way down south; it's only six hours from LAX our first Adventure was incredible, and that's precisely why we're returning for our second time.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Southern California Bluefin Tuna Fishing at Its Finest
programme.desc: Today on Stoked On Fishing, we head offshore on the Stoked On Fishing Charters 35-foot Everglades with an All-Star crew searching for bluefin tuna. We take out Okuma Fishing Tackles President Doug and John, head of product development. We also have on board Colin and his wife, Amanda from Grundens, and our friend Toby from Mag Bay Lures and Mag Bay Resort down in Baja, Mexico. programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - An Unforgettable Trip, South Lake, Part Two
programme.desc: This show was filmed in late October of 2019. Four months prior, in June of 2019, Tim Carnahan was diagnosed with Glioblastoma, Brain Cancer. According to Tim's medical team, his life expectancy could be between three months and 18 months. Fast forward to now, 2020; today's update is one we hoped would never come. With a heavy heart and tear-filled eyes, we share with you that Tim Carnahan has passed away after battling for close to 12 months. It only fits that the last words to pass his lips were I love you, Lory, and keep fishing. While his time on earth was cut short, the amount of joy he experienced and shared with others was genuinely tremendous and will never be forgotten. If you would like to help out in any way, lory and friends have put together a Go Fund Me page to ease the financial burden of medical bills and afford lory some time to greave and transition into life without Tim. We love you, Tim. Rest in peace, buddy.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Mike heads to Table Rock Lake to meet up with Trenton and his family. Even battling the tough fishing conditions following a heavy front, there’s never a lack of family time, laughs or friendly competitions with the Southards.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Trenton is headed to meet up with Andrew Norbye on Lake Guntersville in Alabama. With not a lot of current being pulled, the deep schools weren’t set up to feed. So they went up shallow to fish grass until evening time when the ledge fish really started biting.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Catherine Cohen: Come For Me
programme.desc: In this acclaimed one-woman show, comedian and cabaret star Catherine Cohen delivers a sharp, musical, and self-aware exploration of modern womanhood. Blending stand-up, original songs, and theatrical flair, Cohen takes the audience through her thoughts on dating, therapy, faith, and self-image — all with biting wit, charm, and glitter. Filmed live in New York City, Come For Me celebrates confidence, vulnerability, and the chaos of being thirty and thriving.

programme.title: P!NK: The Truth About Love Tour - Live From Melbourne

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum artist Darius Rucker joins Joel Madden to reflect on his journey from fronting Hootie & the Blowfish to becoming a country music icon. Rucker opens up about balancing family and touring, the band’s legacy, and the honesty that drives his songwriting. He also discusses breaking barriers in country music and his new memoir, Life’s Too Short, offering heartfelt insight into perseverance and authenticity.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Dasha. Born in San Luis Obispo, California, Dasha started performing at ten and released her first song at thirteen. After years as an independent artist, her 2023 single "Austin (Boots Stop Workin')" went viral and landed her a deal with Warner Records. Since then, she's made her Grand Ole Opry debut, joined the Spotify Billions Club, and toured with Thomas Rhett and Luke Bryan.

programme.title: Nos Amis
programme.desc: Nos Amis follows Eagles of Death Metal members Jesse Hughes and Josh Homme as they recount their experiences before, during, and after the 2015 terrorist attack at the Bataclan Theatre in Paris. Blending intimate interviews, archival footage, and emotional reflection, the documentary explores trauma, friendship, and the unifying power of rock and roll.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Entrepreneur and author Vishen Lakhiani, founder and CEO of Mindvalley, joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on mindfulness, compassion, and redefining success. Together they explore meditation, conscious living, and how self-awareness and emotional intelligence can transform relationships, business, and personal growth.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden interviews Pat Monahan of Train about their success, scoring Begin Again, and the band's upcoming tour.

programme.title: Jessi Cruickshank: Minivan Money
programme.desc: Comedian and TV host Jessi Cruickshank takes the stage in Toronto for her first stand-up special, Minivan Money. Known as “the funniest woman on television” (The Province), Cruickshank dives into the chaos of motherhood with biting honesty and fearless humor. From pumping breastmilk onstage to lusting after preschool dads, she turns the absurd realities of parenting into sharp, self-aware comedy. Blending storytelling, satire, and confessional wit, this live performance captures a comedian in full command of her craft — raw, real, and hilariously relatable.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy Award–winning country singer-songwriter Lainey Wilson joins Joel Madden to talk about growing up in rural Louisiana, chasing her Nashville dreams, and building a career through perseverance and purpose. They discuss her new album Whirlwind, the balance between ambition and well-being, and the lessons that come from hardship, therapy, and self-discovery.

programme.title: Paul Weller on Wild Wood
programme.desc: Paul Weller reflects on creating Wild Wood and his early-’90s reinvention. The film explores his analog shift and key tracks “Wild Wood,” “Sunflower,” and “Moon on Your Pyjamas.”

programme.title: Waterparks: FANDOM Live in the UK
programme.desc: A kinetic concert film captured at a sold-out O2 Academy Birmingham (Jan 2020), where Waterparks perform FANDOM through an alternate-universe lens. Executive producers Awsten Knight and Jawn Rocha fuse practical and special effects so every song looks the way it feels on stage—euphoric, chaotic, and intimate. Setlist highlights include crowd-igniting moments like “Dream Boy,” “High Definition,” “Dizzy,” and more, with circle pits, call-and-response, and fourth-wall breaks as the band records a live CD/DVD with the audience.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy starts to worry her whims might have consequences and brings in a scientist and a theologist to unpack chaos theory, the butterfly effect, and free will—while she processes the futility of it all. A game-show parody (“Lucky Case Game”) goes off the rails, the house band Rodent’s Revenge keeps the chaos moving, and Poppy “liberates” her beloved plants with the gift of free will. TV-14. Fictional violence and language.

programme.title: Apache Gold
programme.desc: The construction of the Great Western Railroad causes tension between settlers and Native American tribes. Criminal gang leader Santer seeks control of a gold mine on sacred Apache land and manipulates the railroad route through it. Old Shatterhand, working as a surveyor, uncovers the scheme and tries to warn the Apaches to prevent war.

programme.title: Gunfight at Red Sands
programme.desc: An avenging outsider riddles a gang of ruthless bandits in revenge for the murder of his family.

programme.title: A Pistol for Django
programme.desc: When Django’s fiancée is kidnapped by the ruthless Cortez brothers after a bank robbery, he joins forces with an American ally and agent Fulton, who’s tasked with recovering the stolen gold. Together, they face the gang hiding in a remote cave for a perilous rescue and revenge mission.

programme.title: Cjamango
programme.desc: Just when Cjamango has won a bag of gold in a poker game, he is attacked by the gangs of El Tigre and Don Pablo.

programme.title: Payment in Blood
programme.desc: In 1867 Texas, after the Civil War, Colonel Thomas Blake and his men refuse to surrender, raiding Yankee towns. Rumors swirl that Blake kills for pleasure, not the Confederacy, leading to large bounties for his capture. However, Blake seeks $200,000 that vanished during the war from Confederate coffers. He sends Chamaco Gonzales to track down the missing fortune, hidden in General Beauregard's strong box.

programme.title: Raise Your Hands, Dead Man, You're Under Arrest
programme.desc: The sole survivor, named Sando Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence), of a massacre in the North seeks revenge. After suffering the atrocity, the Kid executes a solo revenge, razes, beats and kills everyone involved in the massacre.

programme.title: Quintana: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: In a Mexican province oppressed by the evil Governor Don Juan de Leyra, the rebel-outlaw Quintana is the sole guardian of justice.

programme.title: Murieta!

programme.title: Seven Guns for the MacGregors
programme.desc: Ranch owner MacGregor has seven sons and oldest Gregor leads his brothers to Las Mesas, a small town where they want to sell horses. They get into trouble with local people who are related with evil Santillana. After getting imprisoned and losing their horses they decide to go after Santillana's gang.

programme.title: Fighters from Ave Maria
programme.desc: Western spaghetti set in gold rush times in California, involving circus acrobats, outlaws and a gold mine.

programme.title: They Called Him Trinity
programme.desc: An ex-sheriff sets out to find the bandits who beat and murdered his sister.

programme.title: Death Knows No Time
programme.desc: A poor Mexican farmer, evicted from his land, turns to banditry and ends up in prison. While he serves his sentence, his young son is adopted by a wealthy family. Once freed, he sets out to reclaim both his child and the $200,000 he hid after a bank robbery, facing a struggle between love and greed.
